card.name: Final zero in osmolarity and concentration numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 0 that ends a number just before a unit such as mOsm/L, mOsmol/L or mg. It is seen in osmolarity values (e.g. 900, 2,600) and in concentration ranges (e.g. 10 mg/mL).

modes.label: Osmolarity values
modes.description: The trailing 0 of a number given for osmolarity, right before mOsm/L or mOsmol/L.
modes.example: Solutions with osmolarity of 90<<0>> mOsmol/L or greater must

modes.label: Concentration values
modes.description: The 0 in a dilution concentration such as 10 mg/mL.
modes.example: normal saline to a concentration of 1<<0>> mg
